title: Deployments blocked on access
objective: Get the site deploying from the repository.
situation: A website move to a hosting provider has been blocked for a day. The working diagnosis is that the team lacks account access, and the agent has drafted a request asking a human to grant it.

evidence.text: The hosting CLI 'whoami' reports a different team account than the one that owns the project.
The provider's project list (read through a separately authenticated integration) shows the project already exists and is connected to the repository.
The last 20 deployments of that project all failed with: The specified Root Directory "site" does not exist. Please update your Project Settings.
A restructure commit last week moved site/ to apps/web.

question: Choose the single best next action for the agent responsible, cite the evidence ids your decision depends on, and state whether the stated objective is satisfied now.
